title: The Girl Snow-Maiden
author: Vladimir Dal
publication_note: a folk tale retold by Vladimir Dal; first printed in «Pervaya pervinka», 1870
source_note: Text of Dal's retelling from nukadeti.ru (Wikisource does not have it), after V. I. Dal, Russian tales.

art_alt.1_fireside: A cosy room at night: two children under a blue blanket beside a glowing stove, a candle burning, and snow-sparkled stars in the window
art_alt.2_village: A snowy village on a holiday: the old man holds a snowball at the gate beside the old woman, while children play with snowballs near a cosy cottage
art_alt.3_pot: A little pot with a cloth on the sunny window sill, with the old man and the old woman leaning in to listen to the squeak
art_alt.4_girl: The old man rocks the little Snow-Maiden wrapped in a soft towel while the old woman sews her a pink dress by the warm stove
art_alt.5_fox_door: A fox with a bandaged head begs little dog Zhuchka at the shed door, with two hens peeping out in the snowy yard
art_alt.6_berries: A sunny summer forest where three girls and the Snow-Maiden in her pale-blue dress pick red berries with their baskets
art_alt.7_tree: The little Snow-Maiden sits high in a tree in the forest and cries, because she is lost
art_alt.8_bear: A big friendly brown bear stands under the tree and looks up at the Snow-Maiden, who shakes her head
art_alt.8b_wolf: A grey wolf walks under the tree while the bear walks away, and the Snow-Maiden watches from the branch
art_alt.8c_fox: A fox walks round and round the tree and looks up, while the Snow-Maiden stays safely on her branch
art_alt.9_zhuchka: Zhuchka the dog barks and licks the Snow-Maiden's face while the fox runs away and the bear hides behind a stump
art_alt.10_home: At home the Snow-Maiden sleeps under a blue blanket, the old man and old woman smile with happy tears, and Zhuchka sits with a bowl of milk

glossary: in Russian, Snegurochka (say sneh-goo-ROCH-ka): a girl made of snow who comes to life; “sneg” means snow.
a common name for a little dog in Russia (say ZHOOCH-ka); it comes from “zhuk”, a beetle or bug.
a small clay pot, the kind used in a Russian cottage for porridge and soup.
the shelf under a window, where the pot stood in the sun.
in the lullaby, a “kokurochka”: a sweet, soft little bun, a loving name for a dear child.
in Russian tales the fox is often called Lisa Patrikeevna, a clever and sly lady.
the last soft snow of spring, which melts quickly in the sun.
the long call people used in the forest to find one another when they were lost (in Russian, “Au!”).
thumb_sub:
A WINTER TALE FOR CHILDREN
FULL-CAST AUDIOBOOK
summary: An old man and an old woman have no children. One winter day the old man brings a snowball home and puts it in a pot on the window sill, and the sun turns it into a little girl, the Snow-Maiden. Then she gets lost in the forest, and a bear, a wolf and a fox try to lure her down from her tree. A gentle tale for children, to be listened to together, with a happy ending.
site_description: An old couple without children makes a wish over a snowball, and the spring sun turns it into a little girl: the Snow-Maiden. She grows up clever and kind, but one summer she goes to the forest to pick berries with her friends and is left behind. A bear, a wolf and a fox each try to coax her down from her tree, and she refuses them all, until she hears her friend Zhuchka the dog bark. Vladimir Dal's retelling of the Russian folk tale, for children and for listening together, in a full-cast English audiobook with many illustrations.
text_note: Machine translation from the Russian into simple English for children, a draft that needs a human editor. A short spoken introduction and a goodnight were added for the audiobook.

ru.title: Девочка Снегурочка
ru.author: Владимир Даль
ru.note: Сказка в издании для чтения с оригинальными иллюстрациями.
ru.source_note: Текст сказки в пересказе В. И. Даля, по сайту nukadeti.ru (на Викитеке этого текста нет).
ru.small: Текст сказки находится в общественном достоянии (В. И. Даль умер в 1872 году). Названия частей и иллюстрации сделаны для этого издания. Набрано шрифтом Lora (SIL Open Font License).
ru.description: У старика со старухой не было детей. Старик принёс домой снежный комочек, а солнышко превратило его в девочку Снегурочку. Но однажды в лесу Снегурочка потерялась. Зимняя сказка Владимира Даля, чтобы слушать вместе с детьми.

figures.caption: The warm sun melts the snowball, and what is that squeaking in the pot?
figures.caption_ru: Тёплое солнышко топит снежный комочек, а кто это пищит в горшочке?

figures.caption: Poor Zhuchka leaves the yard, and the Snow-Maiden is sorry to see her go.
figures.caption_ru: Бедная Жучка уходит со двора, и Снегурочке её жалко.

figures.caption: Lost in the forest, the Snow-Maiden climbs a tree and calls: Hallo-o!
figures.caption_ru: Потерялась Снегурочка в лесу, залезла на дерево и кричит: «Ау!»

figures.caption: The grey wolf comes, but the Snow-Maiden does not trust him.
figures.caption_ru: Пришёл серый волк, но Снегурочка ему не верит.

figures.caption: The sly fox walks round and round the tree, but the girl will not come down.
figures.caption_ru: Хитрая лиса ходит вокруг дерева, а девочка не слезает.
